title: codex-review-verdict
description: JSON Schema for the structured output that codex must emit when invoked with --output-schema. The router reads this JSON and maps it to the pm:pr-review comment template + pr-meta.sh emit-block call.

verdict.description: Overall review verdict. 'approved' = no actionable findings; 'changes-requested' = actionable findings present (maps to pr-review/changes-requested + pr-status/needs-fix); 'ready' = check phase passed all prior findings (maps to pr-status/ready).

findings.description: List of individual review findings. Empty when verdict=approved or verdict=ready with no regressions.

fileLine.description: File and line reference in the form 'path/to/file.go:42'. Required by pr-comment.md convention: /fix relies on this to locate findings without re-reviewing.

p.description: Severity per PROJECT.md §3.1: P0=release-blocker/data-loss/CVE, P1=arch/security/correctness critical, P2=normal debt, P3=deferred/optional.

cx.description: Complexity per PROJECT.md §3.2: Cx1=single-file, Cx2=same-pkg ≤5 files, Cx3=cross-pkg 5-15 files, Cx4=cross-pkg >15 files or arch change.

dimension.description: Review dimension (e.g. 安全, 正确性, DX, 运维, 架构, 测试). Free-form label, used in the pm:pr-review comment header.

summary.description: One-sentence finding description. Must be actionable and include enough context for /fix to act on it. Rendered in the Findings list of the pm:pr-review comment.

evidence.description: Optional: code snippet or quoted text as evidence. Placed in the <details> full table of the pm:pr-review comment.

suggestion.description: Optional: suggested fix direction. Placed in the <details> full table.

checkStatus.description: Used only in check-phase output (verdict=ready or changes-requested for a check run). Maps to ✅/❌/⚠️/🔧 in the --check variant of the pm:pr-review comment.

counts.description: Aggregated counts for the pr-review comment header and for the pr-meta.sh emit-block findings facts.

byP.description: Finding counts broken down by P severity level.

byCx.description: Finding counts broken down by Cx complexity level. Router uses cx2/cx3/cx4 to gate the alternate fix path (Cx1-only check).

summary.description: Optional: one-paragraph review summary for the pm:pr-review comment header block.

rootCauseClusters.description: Optional: high-level root-cause clusters grouping related findings. Helps the /fix agent prioritise systemic issues. Not required; omit when findings are unrelated.

label.description: Human-readable cluster label rendered in the pm:pr-review comment.

findingRefs.description: fileLine values from the findings array that belong to this cluster.
